name: Angus Imrie
bio:
Angus Imrie (born 2 August 1994) is a British actor. Born to actors Celia Imrie and Benjamin Whitrow, he made his acting debut at the age of five in BBC's Station Jim (2001).

He is known for portraying Young Merlin in The Kid Who Would Be King (2019), Rodney in The Road Trip (2024), Agent Charlie in Mickey 17 (2025), and a variety of other roles in film, television, and stage productions.
